sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: On a quiet, tree-lined street in a neighborhood that preserves a significant part of São Paulo's residential tradition, Casa Arbo emerges from a simple idea: to create a building capable of offering the spatial quality, comfort, and connection to nature typically associated with a house, without sacrificing the qualities of urban living. Designed by Perkins&Will São Paulo , the building embodies a contemporary vision of living, in which architecture, landscape, and the city function as inseparable parts of a single experience.
